presentation_rules_enforced.official_records: facts/review only; upload 202, job done, transcript text and committed candidates never become record cards
presentation_rules_enforced.identity_stability: one recording = one utterance identity; re-submit of the same recordingID is ignored; retry reuses identical utterance_id/sequence/bytes; refresh/leave/retry never regenerate identities
presentation_rules_enforced.dedup: facts by fact id, events by event_seq, pending by stable key; repeated refreshes never duplicate cards
presentation_rules_enforced.decode_failures: records refresh failure keeps previous data and surfaces an error banner; never rendered as 'no pending content'
